name: System Administrator
description: System configuration, users and technical settings. Not a regulatory decision maker.

name: Security Administrator
description: Users, roles, permissions, security and security audit.

name: Regulatory Data Administrator
description: Regulatory Data Model, classifications, identifier types and reporting metadata.

name: Integration Administrator
description: Integration Manager, connections, health and provider configuration.

name: Registration Officer
description: Processes registration submissions.

name: Entity Resolution Officer
description: Resolves regulated-entity identity cases.

name: Entity Resolution Supervisor
description: Approves resolution decisions and controlled entity merges.

name: Licensing Officer
description: Processes licence applications day-to-day.

name: Licensing Supervisor
description: Reviews and decides licence applications and issuance.

name: Prudential Analyst
description: Prudential analysis and returns review.

name: Prudential Supervisor
description: Prudential supervisory decisions and examinations.

name: Conduct Analyst
description: Market conduct analysis and complaint investigation.

name: Conduct Supervisor
description: Market conduct supervisory decisions.

name: Fit & Proper Officer
description: Processes fit & proper assessments.

name: Fit & Proper Supervisor
description: Fit & proper determinations.

name: Returns Officer
description: Processes regulatory returns.

name: Returns Supervisor
description: Approves regulatory returns.

name: Inspector
description: Conducts inspections and onsite work.

name: Enforcement Officer
description: Prepares and progresses enforcement matters.

name: Correspondence Officer
description: Handles regulatory correspondence.

name: Regulatory Analyst
description: Cross-module analysis and reporting.

name: Auditor
description: Read-only assurance access across regulatory records.

name: Read Only
description: Ordinary operational read-only access.

name: Regulatory Forms Designer
description: Designs form definitions, fields, concept bindings and draft packages. Cannot publish.

name: Regulatory Forms Publisher
description: Reviews and publishes form versions and activates applicability.

name: Entity Structure Officer
description: Reviews submitted ownership, governance and relationship changes and prepares change sets.

name: Entity Structure Supervisor
description: Approves and applies entity structural changes and controlled data corrections.

name: Complaints Officer
description: Intake, triage and investigation of consumer complaints.

name: Complaints Supervisor
description: Approves complaint RFIs, escalations and closures.

name: Enforcement Supervisor
description: Decides enforcement outcomes and sanctions.

name: Legal Counsel
description: Legal review of licensing, enforcement and appeal matters.

name: AML/CFT Supervision Officer
description: AML/CFT risk assessment and confidential findings.

name: AML/CFT Supervision Supervisor
description: Approves AML/CFT assessments and findings.

name: Operational Resilience Officer
description: Operational resilience and continuity oversight.

name: Regulatory Coordination Officer
description: Cross-regulator coordination cases and referrals.

name: Regulatory Coordination Supervisor
description: Approves coordination escalations and overrides.

name: Appeals Panel Member
description: Independent determination of licensing and F&P appeals.

name: Executive Management
description: Cross-module executive oversight and reporting.

name: Payment Systems Supervisor
description: FMI, MSB and PFMI oversight.

name: Inspection Supervisor
description: Plans examinations and signs off workpapers.

name: Workflow Administrator
description: Designs and publishes approval workflows and SLAs.

name: Rule Engine Administrator
description: Authors, tests and activates supervisory rules.

name: Notification Administrator
description: Owns notification templates, events and channels.

name: Licensee Primary User
description: Submits returns, applications and filings for the licensee.

name: Licensee Secondary User
description: Prepares filings but cannot submit them.

name: Entity Primary Point of Contact
description: Manages entity users and confirms entity data.

name: Applicant
description: Applies for authorisation before licensing.

name: Pre-Licensee
description: Registered entity awaiting authorisation.
